name: zovo-code-screenshot
displayName: Code Screenshot & Code Snapshot (Copy Code as Image, PNG/SVG)
description: Code screenshot and code snapshot in one key: select code, press Cmd+Alt+C (Shift+Alt+C) and a PNG of it is on your clipboard, in your editor theme, font and colors. Save PNG or SVG, line numbers, highlights, window frame, backgrounds. Free, no sign-in, works offline.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode the save folder settings of the workspace are not used.

codeScreenshot.scale.description: PNG pixels per point: 2 is sharp on most screens, 3 or 4 for print and slides. Changes in the panel are remembered and win over this default.

codeScreenshot.lineNumbers.description: Show line numbers. They are the real line numbers from the file.

enumDescriptions: A window with three dots and a title.
A window with a title, no dots.
No window: just the code on its background.
codeScreenshot.frame.description: The window frame around the code.

codeScreenshot.showTitle.description: Show the file name (or your own title from the panel) in the window frame.

enumDescriptions: Transparent (PNG and SVG keep the transparency)

codeScreenshot.backgroundColor.description: The color for the "solid" background, as #rrggbb.

codeScreenshot.padding.description: Space around the window, in points.

codeScreenshot.shadow.description: Draw a shadow under the window (needs some padding).

codeScreenshot.cornerRadius.description: Rounded corners of the window, in points.

codeScreenshot.removeCommonIndent.description: Remove the indent that all selected lines share, so a nested block starts at the left edge. The indent inside the block stays as it is.

codeScreenshot.wrapColumn.description: Wrap long lines at this many columns. 0 means no wrapping. Wrapped parts keep the line's indent and have no line number.

codeScreenshot.fontFamily.description: Font for the picture. Empty uses your editor font (editor.fontFamily), with its size, weight, ligatures and line height.

codeScreenshot.maxLines.description: Draw at most this many lines. A longer selection draws the first lines and says how many were left out.

codeScreenshot.maxLineLength.description: Longer lines are cut at this many characters (for example minified files), and the panel says so.

enumDescriptions: Take the lines you can see in the editor.
Take the whole file (up to codeScreenshot.maxLines).
codeScreenshot.whenNothingSelected.description: What to take when nothing is selected.

codeScreenshot.saveFolder.description: Folder for saved pictures. Empty uses the last folder you saved to, then the file's folder. You can use ~ and ${workspaceFolder}.

codeScreenshot.askWhereToSave.description: Show the save dialog. When off, Save writes <file>-L12-L40.png into the save folder at once (with -2, -3 if the name is taken).

codeScreenshot.followSelection.description: While the panel is open, update the picture when you select other lines in the same file.

codeScreenshot.askForRating.description: Ask for a Marketplace rating after you have used Code Screenshot on a few days. You can answer "Later" or "No thanks". Nothing is sent anywhere.

codeScreenshot.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links at the bottom of the panel (never in the picture). Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Code Screenshot
walkthroughs.description: Turn selected code into a PNG on your clipboard with one key. No account and no network.

steps.title: Copy code as an image
steps.description:
Select some lines and press Cmd+Alt+C (Shift+Alt+C on Windows and Linux), or right-click and pick Copy as Image. The PNG is on your clipboard: paste it into a chat, a doc or a slide.
[Copy the selection now](command:codeScreenshot.copy)

steps.title: Frame, background and highlights
steps.description: Open Options in the panel: window frame, title, background, padding, shadow, line numbers and wrapping. Click a line to highlight it, double-click a word to mark it.

steps.title: Save PNG or SVG
steps.description: Save PNG or Save SVG names the file after the lines, like app.ts-L12-L40.png, in the folder you used last. SVG keeps the text as text.

steps.title: Defaults and limits
steps.description:
Pick the defaults for new pictures, the save folder and the size limits.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22codeScreenshot%22%5D)

scripts.package: node scripts/build.js --production && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist-vsix',{recursive:true})" && npx -y @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dist-vsix/
